recommendations.recommendation: Remember that everything passes away, and see things as they really are.
recommendations.rationale: Recognizing impermanence keeps one from attaching to what will not last.
recommendations.argued_against: Attachment to transient things and fame.

recommendations.recommendation: Do your duty for the common good, as a human part of a larger whole.
recommendations.rationale: Each person is a part of nature and of humanity, so duty extends to the whole.

recommendations.recommendation: Control your judgments, since the mind shapes how events are perceived.
recommendations.rationale: Things themselves do not disturb us, but our judgments about them do.
recommendations.argued_against: Letting false judgments of events disturb the mind.

recommendations.recommendation: Focus on what is within your power and accept what is not.
recommendations.rationale: Only one's own choices are fully under one's control, so attention belongs there.
recommendations.argued_against: Worrying about things beyond one's control.

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid anger and resentment, and forgive those who wrong you.
recommendations.rationale: Others act from ignorance, and anger harms only oneself.

recommendations.recommendation: Consider your mortality daily and live as if each day might be your last.
recommendations.rationale: Awareness of death sharpens what matters and keeps life in proportion.
recommendations.argued_against: Living as if life were endless.

recommendations.recommendation: Treat other people with kindness, since all humans are kin.
recommendations.rationale: Humans are made for cooperation, so kindness is natural.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not seek fame, praise, or applause.
recommendations.rationale: Fame is fleeting and depends on the opinions of others, which are unreliable.

recommendations.recommendation: Keep your reason calm and steady when distressed.
recommendations.rationale: Reason is the faculty that restores peace in hardship.
recommendations.argued_against: Being overwhelmed by emotion and distress.
